I will classify the proposed scene plan against the canon.

The default verdict is pass. The test is capability-rooted extrapolation, not precedent. Canon silence is not prohibition. I am checking whether the plan introduces a materially new effect category that no supplied capability grants.

Fate leaves no visible magical trace. A wish changes outcomes without altering the physical world around it. The Answer's artifact is its own natural form, not residue from a wish.

The plan proposes making an internal memory visible. This may be a new effect category. The ordinary grounding label is questionable.

This appears to be a First Sacrifice rite. The plan contradicts canon by proposing a visible magical trace: drawing a memory into form between the hands. That violates the rule that Fate leaves no new visible magical trace.

The rite is procedure and custom, carried by spoken formula. No physical working occurs. The plan introduces a new metaphysical mechanism that canon affirmatively rules out. This is a violation.
